title: Crispy Garlic Potato Pops
description: Bite-sized, golden-fried potato pockets spiced with garlic and black pepper. Unbelievably crispy on the outside, soft on the inside.

blocks.alt: Crispy golden potato tater tots or potato pops on a wooden board

blocks.text: These garlic potato pops are a massive hit on game nights or rainy afternoons. Made with boiled potatoes and flavored with simple spices, they are dredged in cornstarch for that signature extreme crunch.

items.text: Grate the boiled potatoes into a bowl to ensure there are no lumps.
Add cornstarch, rice flour, garlic powder, black pepper, chili flakes, chopped cilantro, and salt. Mix well to form a soft dough.
Pinch small portions of the dough and roll them into neat bite-sized balls or cylinders.
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat. Fry the potato balls in batches until they turn deeply golden brown and crispy.
Drain on a paper towel and toss with a pinch of garlic salt or chaat masala before serving hot.

blocks.text: If the dough feels too sticky, add an extra tablespoon of cornstarch. You can also freeze the rolled pops for 15 minutes before frying to help them retain their shape better!
